kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتزع (form VIII)
# أَنْتَزِعُ (ʔantaziʕu) /ʔan.ta.zi.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# أُنْتَزَعُ (ʔuntazaʕu) /ʔun.ta.za.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# أَنْتَزِعَ (ʔantaziʕa) /ʔan.ta.zi.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# أُنْتَزَعَ (ʔuntazaʕa) /ʔun.ta.za
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
